memories.subject: Bob authority model
memories.content: Bob Core is the authoritative owner of Bob identity, approved memory, project state, decisions, tasks, and cross-surface continuity; BobAI, Codex, ChatGPT, and other AI clients are interfaces rather than separate owners of Bob.

memories.subject: BobAI repository layout
memories.content: The BobAI repository is boisey9/BobAI. It contains the native SwiftUI iPhone client in BobAI/, the TypeScript/Hono Bob Core backend in Core/, and the owner-facing Bob Control Center in Web/.

memories.subject: Durable Bob state
memories.content: Bob Core persists durable memory and structured project state in Neon PostgreSQL and exposes shared project context through MCP. AI model providers remain replaceable reasoning engines behind Bob Core.

memories.subject: Memory boundaries
memories.content: Approved persistent memory, conversation history, structured project state, and executable tools are separate layers. Ordinary chat transcripts are not automatically promoted into persistent Bob memory.

memories.subject: Bob project workflow
memories.content: BobAI follows the Bob Project Standard: substantial work retrieves Bob Core context, inspects the repository, uses a feature or fix branch, validates build/runtime/functional gates as applicable, records a detailed docs/changes entry, and updates implementation.md.

memories.subject: BobAI visual identity
memories.content: BobAI's visual direction uses the glowing B/Core object as both the app-icon identity and the interactive in-app core, with animated states for idle, listening, thinking, and speaking.

memories.subject: BobAI project manifest
memories.content: BobAI uses project key bobai and the repository manifest .bob/project.yml to identify its source-of-truth mappings, interfaces, runtime providers, standards, and security declarations without storing current tasks, decisions, or memories in the manifest.
